the next shot is the new projector pod being installed, the other side of the comparison

cards.text: First night with the real one 😎🇺🇸
cards.shows: real badge projected sharp first night
cards.why: the payoff is the new real projector throwing a sharp badge on its first night

hook.first_second_action: a group of 3 friends in a store parking lot at night huddle around the pod covered by a small cloth in his palm and start counting 'three' together
hook.conflict: countdown suspense: everyone leans in counting '3, 2, 1' over the covered pod; what's under the cloth?

count321.covered_cue_at_0: black pod with round lens peeking from under a red cloth in his palm, legible at 0.0 s
count321.reveal_line: let's see how it comes out

hook.prompt_frame: Photorealistic vertical phone frame, night, store parking lot under orange sodium lights, pickup truck with a US flag on a pole in the bed. Three friends (a man holding it, a woman and another man) huddle close; in his open palm a small black square car-door projector pod with a round lens peeks out from under a red cloth. All three look at the covered pod, mid-count, excited. No text, no watermark.
hook.prompt_clip: All three count out loud together 'three, two, one'; on 'one' he whips the cloth off and for a split second the pod flashes a round glowing badge onto the asphalt, then the woman says 'let's see how it comes out' as he closes his hand over it. Handheld, natural voices, parking-lot ambience. No text, no music.

cards.text: Don't show this to a liberal 😎🦅
cards.shows: pod badge projector he is about to show off
cards.why: he is counting down to show off a Trump badge projector, the 'this' nobody on the other side wants to see
